utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane! I’m helping coordinate the repair drive—are you planning to bring tools, something that needs fixing, or maybe extension cords so I can add you to the confirmed list?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Quinn, put me down for basic tools and a couple extension cords, and I’m also collecting repair notes since I’m the loose point person. Cleo’s keeping the main list tidy, so I’ll make sure she gets whatever I confirm today.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Dane—I’ll mark you confirmed for basic tools and a couple extension cords, and I’ll send any other firm replies your way so you and Cleo can keep the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Nell. The repair drive is Saturday from 9 to noon in my garage, with drop-off just inside the garage and parking along the school-side curb.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Eli—that helps a lot. I’ll pass along Saturday 9 to noon at your garage, drop-off inside, and parking on the school-side curb, and keep routing repair requests toward Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Nell—let’s route the requests to Dane so he can get them onto Cleo’s list, and I’ll have the bring-list posted today.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Kira, I’m checking with parents at pickup today about basic tools for the repair drive, but I still need to keep any volunteering around drop-off and pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Faye—before I tell Rosa you can help around pickup, can you confirm which times you’re actually free and what tools you’re offering?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do late morning after drop-off until about 1:30, and then again after pickup if needed. I’m not offering my own tools yet—I’m asking parents today about screwdrivers, pliers, and other basics, and I’ll confirm what’s firm.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—Cleo, I’m a bit behind, but Hana confirmed drop-off is Saturday morning in the community room for small appliances, bikes, lamps, and mending stuff. I’m still checking who’s coordinating the urgent list and where they need hands most.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Noah—I’ll note Saturday morning in the community room for those drop-offs, and I’ll keep the urgent supply list to confirmed items until you hear who’s coordinating hands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo—that’s safest. I’ll nudge Hana and Rosa, and if I hear the confirmed volunteer gaps, I’ll pass them straight along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Vik, could you help make a couple of simple parking signs and stand near the curb for the first half hour so the drop-off line doesn’t creep into the street?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, Pia—I can make a couple simple parking signs and stand by the curb for the first half hour to keep the drop-off line out of the street.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thank you, Vik—that eases my mind. Let’s keep the signs clear: parking on the side street, drop-off by Eli’s garage, and no stopping in the lane.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hana, I’m still gathering confirmed repair drive details—Eli’s garage is set for Saturday 9 to noon, but I’m waiting on firm tool commitments before I pass around a list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I’ll hold off on sharing a tool list until you confirm it. I do have the drop-off details as the community room Saturday morning, so I want to double-check whether Eli’s garage is for volunteer setup or a separate repair spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good catch, Hana — I only have Eli’s garage confirmed for Saturday 9 to noon, and Opal told me the community center lobby still needs Mira’s confirmation, so I’ll double-check before anyone shares drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, can you help with Saturday setup, and do you have any sturdy bins or work gloves we can borrow for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes, Mina—I can come help set up Saturday, though remind me if it’s before 9. I’ve got two sturdy bins and a pair of work gloves you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please bring the two bins and gloves, and plan for 8:30 Saturday if you can make it; if that’s too early, tell me now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Mara, I’ve only caught the basics from Rosa—small appliances and tools with labels—but can you confirm where drop-offs are before I tell anyone?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes—please tell folks drop-offs are at the community room on Saturday morning, and we’re taking small appliances, bikes, lamps, and mending items with labels and any loose parts included.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—community room Saturday morning, with labels and loose parts; I’ll pass that along without overcomplicating it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Jules, my latest note says the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, with Rosa collecting small fixable-item notes for priorities.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Opal—I had Saturday morning in the community room from Hana, so I’ll check with Mara and Rosa before I pass along the Sunday update.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules—please hold off on spreading Saturday for now, since my current confirmed note is Sunday at the community center via Rosa. Let me know what Mara and Rosa say, and I’ll update the location list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rosa, we’re focusing first on safety repairs—porch rails, steps, and wiring. I’m still waiting on Ira for the exact Saturday start time; can you help with any carpentry, cleanup, or sorting?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo—I can help with sorting and cleanup, and I’ll update the list for safety repairs first; just a quick flag that the drive’s now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa—good catch. I’ll switch my notes to Sunday at the community center and put you down for sorting, cleanup, and keeping safety repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rey. I heard the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, and Rosa may have me at a small quiet station—if there’s anything simple you know needs doing, I can help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli—that quiet station sounds really useful. If you’re comfortable, simple sorting like gloves, labeled bins, batteries, or patch kits would help while Rosa gathers the repair requests.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds alright, thank you. I’ll come Sunday and keep to the sorting—gloves, bins, batteries, patch kits—whatever Rosa needs most.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, I’m catching up on the repair drive while I’m out—do you know if pickup help is still needed, or should I plan on a repair table role?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Ira, I’m set for setup and the safety repairs crew with my tools Saturday morning, but I haven’t heard whether pickup help is still short. Maybe check with Rosa or Nell before you switch off a repair table role.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, thanks Gus—I’ll check with Rosa or Nell before I commit, and if pickup’s covered I’ll plan on a repair table role.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Vik, I’m already bringing my drill, pliers, toolbox, and labeled extension cords Saturday morning for setup—do you need any other tools from my garage?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Gus—Oren said the repair drive’s Saturday 9 to noon, and Rosa’s gathering requests, so I’ll pass along that you’ve got the drill, pliers, toolbox, and labeled cords ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, thanks Vik—if Rosa hears anyone needs a saw, clamps, or a socket set, just holler and I’ll toss them in too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Hana, I’m still piecing things together quietly for the repair drive—mostly tools, extension cords, gloves, labeled bins, and maybe batteries or patch kits. Do you know what you or nearby folks might be able to spare?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — I know the drop-off is Saturday morning in the community room for labeled items, but I’m still confirming the urgent repair list and volunteer gaps. I’ll check nearby for tools, extension cords, gloves, and labeled bins, and I won’t promise batteries or patch kits until I verify they’re needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Hana — Saturday morning in the community room helps a lot. I’ll keep gathering the basics and wait on batteries or patch kits until you’ve confirmed the urgent list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Mara, I’m still waiting on Ira to confirm the Saturday start time, but we’re lining up safety repairs, carpentry cleanup, and parts sorting. What can you help with?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — I can keep handling intake and labels for small appliances, bikes, lamps, and mending items at the community room Saturday morning. Once Ira confirms the start time, I’ll help push out the final note so folks know when to arrive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, Mara—please stay on intake and labels, and I’ll send you Ira’s confirmed start time as soon as I have it so we can get the final note out.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Dane, I’m set to handle check-in at Eli’s folding table and help sort tools during the repair drive—do you need me to coordinate anything with you too?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Sam — yes, please coordinate check-in with Opal and keep me posted on what tools actually come in, since I’m still piecing Cleo’s list together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Dane—I’ll check in with Opal about the table flow and keep you updated on the tools as they come in so Cleo’s list stays accurate.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, I’m pulling the repair drive pieces together with Mara—would you be up for helping with intake, pickup, or a repair table if we still have a gap?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Maybe, but can you confirm with Rosa what gap actually exists first? I don’t want to sign up for intake or pickup based on guesswork.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, that’s fair—I’ll check with Rosa first and come back to you with the actual gap before asking you to commit.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Opal, I only skimmed the notice, but I still think the drop-offs are meant for the community center lobby—Mira’s probably the one to confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo—I’ll keep the community center lobby marked as tentative and check with Mira before I share it around.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Opal—sorry I’m not more certain, I’ve been dashing around. If I spot the notice again, I’ll send you the exact wording.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Nell, I’m still keeping the repair drive list to confirmed items only—Eli’s garage is set for Saturday 9 to noon, and I’m waiting to hear who’s definitely bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, Tess—Saturday 9 to noon at Eli’s garage, confirmed items only. I’ll keep pointing repair requests and tool offers back to Rosa so the list stays clean.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Nell—send folks to Rosa, and I’ll only pass along the tool list once she’s got firm names attached.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira, for the repair drive, can you handle the check-in table Saturday morning, and do you have any tape, markers, or spare labels to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I can take the check-in table Saturday morning; I’m still confirming the exact start time while I’m out. I can bring markers and a roll of tape, and I’ll check at home for spare labels.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, thanks Ira—please confirm the start time and whether you have labels by Friday evening so I can fill any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren! I’m helping coordinate the repair drive—are you coming, and if so, can you bring tools, extension cords, gloves, bins, or anything that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh hi Quinn — yes, I’m planning to come Saturday morning, if I’ve got that right, and I can bring a couple extension cords and my tool bag. I’ll label them so I don’t wander off without them.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Oren—I’ll mark you confirmed for Saturday morning with labeled extension cords and a tool bag. I’ll pass that along to Tess for the confirmed list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, thanks again for offering—just a quick reminder that the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. If you’re free then, I’d love to put you at a small quiet station.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. Sunday at the community center works for me, and a small quiet station would be just right.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, thank you, Uli—I’ll put you down for Sunday at a small quiet station. I’ll send the exact time and setup details once I finish the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Eli, I’m checking with parents at pickup today about batteries, patch kits, tarps, and cleaning supplies, and I can help at the drive as long as it doesn’t clash with school pickup or drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Faye—that’s useful. The drive is Saturday 9 to noon in my garage, so it shouldn’t clash with school pickup; I’ll add those supplies to the bulletin-board list today.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Eli—Saturday 9 to noon works for me, and I’ll send Cleo any firm parent names after pickup today so your list stays accurate.
